title: An Act to Establish a Biennial Inspection System for Vehicle Rental Companies

summary.text:
This bill is reported out by the Joint Standing Committee on Transportation pursuant to Resolve 2025, chapter 78. The committee is reporting the bill out for the sole purpose of having a bill printed that can be referred to the committee for an appropriate public hearing and subsequent processing in the normal course. The committee is taking this action to ensure clarity and transparency in the legislative review of the proposals contained in the bill.

The bill authorizes a business that rents noncommercial motor vehicles to the public to receive a 2-year certificate of inspection for each vehicle if the business has at least 1,000 noncommercial motor vehicles registered in the State per year and files an affidavit with the Department of Public Safety, Bureau of State Police that includes a statement that the fleet of rental vehicles will meet or exceed the inspection standards set forth in law and administered by the Chief of the State Police over the 2-year period.
